title: Codex add project handoff packet
summary: Use Codex to add a manifest-driven project handoff packet that summarizes the generated planning artifacts for operator use, with focused docs and tests, without performing any live deployment action.

actions.prompt: Add a small manifest-driven project handoff packet path for Cortex project manifests. Prefer extending existing manifest tooling so validated manifests can render a deterministic planning-only handoff artifact or stdout that summarizes the key operator-facing outputs already generated: routing preview, deploy plan, bootstrap checklist, runtime skeleton, env contract, and smoke-check contract. Keep scope tight: do not modify bootstrap/compose/edge/*, do not perform live deployment or health checks, do not change .codex/config.toml, and keep the output as planning/documentation only. Add focused docs/tests and run targeted validation/tests afterward.
